summary: Blocked by the dispatched Core-contract stop rule. Rework2 was reproduced through Core VectorLifecycleCoordinator: when the current generation excludes the deleted Recipe, entry_<recipeId> is removed but rollback-only canonical documents survive and resurrect after rollback. Core retains terminal entryId in its private coordinator, then collapses it to VectorIndexWriter.remove(id); the same entry_<id> remove is also used after live upsert to retire a legacy competitor, so AlembicPlugin cannot safely infer terminal truth from the id or current active visibility. The minimum unblock is an additive, typed, awaited Core Recipe truth-removal port (for example RecipeVectorTruthRemover.removeRecipeByIdentity(recipeId)) wired into VectorLifecycleCoordinator/VectorService terminal remove/deprecate processing; AlembicPlugin can then implement base plus every-known-generation cleanup. No source changes or commit were retained.
